saw_lines: Pool owners buy a heat pump once, after weeks of comparing prices, and trust the seller who answers their install questions.
So the sale is won in the ad, where a comparing buyer needs a reason to click now or keeps scrolling.
Your site answers install questions, but 0 of your 3 ads carry a proof number. Lead the next batch with one order count, one install answer, and three story ads.
ads_1: Three story ads on heat pump installs, each with a first purchase offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube
